title: German E-Invoice Legacy Bridge for SMEs
reason: Pain and regulatory urgency are real, but the proposed wedge is already directly served by multiple vendors offering legacy-ERP integration, API conversion, validation, and AI-assisted mapping/PDF-to-e-invoice conversion. No sufficiently differentiated second-order problem was identified.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic XRechnung/ZUGFeRD conversion or legacy-system adapter
reopen_if: fresh evidence reveals a narrower unsolved workflow with repeated willingness-to-pay signals beyond format conversion/integration

title: Generic EU AI Act compliance automation for SMEs
reason: Regulatory urgency and confusion are real, but the category is crowded with classifiers, documentation generators and compliance trackers; one builder publicly reported commercial failure despite a working automated compliance engine. Trust/distribution strongly favor legal/compliance incumbents.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic AI Act risk classifier, compliance pack generator, AI inventory, or badge for SMEs
reopen_if: fresh evidence reveals a narrow vertical workflow tied to an operational system where compliance is generated as a by-product and users already pay for the underlying workflow

title: Automated freight detention/accessorial recovery for small carriers
reason: Carrier pain and lost revenue are strong, but multiple 2026 vendors already offer ELD/TMS-connected automatic detention detection, evidence capture, claim filing, billing and recovery, including Tollup, Bastion Recovery, Calcutiv/FleetOptos and DockChron.
do_not_rediscover_as: generic detention-pay recovery, ELD geofence evidence capture, or accessorial revenue recovery
reopen_if: a narrower claim type, broker/customer exception, or underserved geography repeatedly appears that current recovery platforms do not support
